title: 第11章 外门狂人目标绝世第12章 打破人体极限吞天养血功圆满
slug: 满级武圣从绝世神功开始
content_zh:
张宿兑换了十三门武技。
他的目标很明确，将这十三门武技全都修炼圆满，以获得大量契合值。
虽然十三门武技的数量很庞大。
可这段时间，张宿的气血达到了极限，在没有修炼吞天养血功之前，他是无法打破人体极限的，无论如何气血都不会再增长。
因此，张宿便把全部的时间和精力，都用来修炼这十三门武技。
时间一天天过去。
张宿有条不紊地修炼着十三门武技。
每一门武技，契合度都在90%以上。
因此，修炼起来无比顺利。
仅仅半个月时间，基本上都大成了。
在张宿看来，这是不值一提的事。
可与张宿同在一个屋檐下的杜天、赵峰以及楚大川，眼睁睁看着张宿修炼十三门武技，居然还游刃有余，而且进展神速。
仅用半个月时间，就全部大成了。
他们心中早就掀起了惊涛骇浪，有一种无与伦比的震撼感。
他们原本心里还有一丁点小心思。
可现在，这些小心思早就烟消云散了。
他们变得无比“忠诚”，一心一意替张宿办事。
张宿要他们办的事也很简单。
替他调查外门当中，有哪一些气血境九层的弟子，修炼与他这十三门武技一样，或者类似的武技。
楚大川三人也不负众望。

他们还给张宿罗列出了一张长长的清单。
张宿也很满意，按照清单上的名字，一个一个地去“挑战”。
或者，楚大川三人也会想办法，替张宿“约战”。
每一次战斗，张宿都只用十三门武技中的一种。
一次两次或许是巧合。
可三次、四次、五次……
随着张宿一次次挑战，他在外门也迅速名声大噪。
整个外门都知道有这么一个“狂人”，疯狂挑战气血境九层的外门弟子。
而且，每一次使用的武技都不一样。
张宿不在意其他人的议论。
他用这种挑战的方式，或许是高调了一点，但效果确实不错。
虽然不能保证每一次战斗都能抓住契机。
但大不了就换一个人便是。
反正外门什么都缺，就是不缺弟子。
“今天是第十三天了，按照张宿以往的规矩，他再去挑战的话，将会动用第十三种武技。”
“此前张宿已经分别挑战了二十一位外门气血境九层弟子，甚至曾经一天之内挑战三位，而且全部都获胜了，无一败绩！”
“有消息传出，当初张宿在传功阁一口气兑换了十三门武技，他挑战的目的，就是为了将这十三门武技都修炼至圆满！”
“真是难以置信，短短半个月，张宿已经将十二门武技都修炼至圆满了，这是何等恐怖的天赋？”
content_en:
Zhang Su exchanged thirteen martial arts.
His goal is very clear, to practice all these thirteen martial arts to perfection in order to obtain a large amount of compatibility points.
Although the number of thirteen martial arts is huge.
But during this period, Zhang Su's qi and blood reached the limit. Before he practiced the swallowing sky and nourishing blood technique, he could not break the limit of the human body, and his qi and blood would not increase no matter what.
Therefore, Zhang Su devoted all his time and energy to practicing these thirteen martial arts.
Time passes day by day.
Zhang Su practiced thirteen martial arts in an orderly manner.
The compatibility of each martial skill is above 90%.
Therefore, practicing is extremely smooth.
In just half a month, it was basically done.
In Zhang Su's opinion, this is something not worth mentioning.
But Du Tian, ​​Zhao Feng and Chu Dachuan, who were under the same roof as Zhang Su, watched Zhang Su practice thirteen martial arts with ease and made rapid progress.
It only took half a month to complete.
A storm had already set off in their hearts, and there was an unparalleled sense of shock.
They originally had a little bit of caution in mind.
But now, these little thoughts have long since disappeared.
They became extremely "loyal" and worked for Zhang Su wholeheartedly.
What Zhang Su wanted them to do was also very simple.
Investigate for him which disciples in the ninth level of Qi and Blood realm among the outer sect are practicing the same or similar martial arts as his thirteen martial arts.
The three of Chu Dachuan lived up to expectations.
They also made a long list for Zhang Suluo.
Zhang Su was also very satisfied and "challenged" one by one according to the names on the list.
Or, Chu Dachuan and the other three would also think of ways to "make a fight" on Zhang Su's behalf.
In every battle, Zhang Su only uses one of the thirteen martial arts.
Once or twice may be a coincidence.
Can be three times, four times, five times...
As Zhang Su challenged him again and again, he quickly became famous in the outer sect.
The entire outer sect knew that there was such a "madman" who crazily challenged the outer sect disciples at the ninth level of Qi and Blood Realm.
Moreover, the martial arts used are different every time.
Zhang Su didn't care about other people's comments.
The way he used this challenge may be a little high-profile, but the effect is really good.
Although there is no guarantee that you can seize the opportunity in every battle.
But in the worst case, just change someone else.
Anyway, the outer sect lacks everything except disciples.
"Today is the thirteenth day. According to Zhang Su's past rules, if he challenges again, he will use the thirteenth martial arts."
"Zhang Su has previously challenged twenty-one disciples of the ninth level of the outer sect's Qi and Blood Realm. He even challenged three in one day, and all of them won without losing!"
"There is news that Zhang Su redeemed thirteen martial arts skills in one go at the Chuan Gong Pavilion. The purpose of his challenge was to practice all thirteen martial arts skills to perfection!"
"It's unbelievable. In just half a month, Zhang Su has perfected all twelve martial arts. What a terrifying talent is this?"
